nodes.summary: Let $m$ be even with $2^a \le m$, and let $X_1, \dots, X_a$ be finite sets of natural numbers. Then there is a set $Y \subseteq \{1, \dots, m + a\}$ with $|Y| = m$ such that $|Y \cap X_i|$ is even for every $i$.
nodes.title: An $m$-subset of $\{1, \dots, m + a\}$ meeting $a$ given sets evenly

nodes.summary: Let $2^a \le m$ and let $X_1, \dots, X_a$ be finite sets of natural numbers. Then there are integers $s, t$ with $1 \le s \le t \le m$ such that $|\{s, s + 1, \dots, t\} \cap X_i|$ is even for every $i$.
nodes.title: A block of consecutive integers meeting $a$ given sets evenly

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{Z}_2 = \mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$, let $2^a \le m$ and let $v_1, \dots, v_a \in \mathbb{Z}_2^m$, with coordinates indexed by $\{0, \dots, m - 1\}$. Then there are indices $s \le t$ in $\{0, \dots, m - 1\}$ such that $\sum_{j = s}^{t} (v_i)_j = 0$ in $\mathbb{Z}_2$ for every $i$; that is, the nonzero vector whose ones occupy exactly the positions $s, \dots, t$ is orthogonal to every $v_i$.
nodes.title: A block of consecutive coordinates orthogonal to $a$ vectors of $\mathbb{Z}_2^m$

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{Z}_2 = \mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$, let $a + 1 \le m$ and let $v_1, \dots, v_a \in \mathbb{Z}_2^m$. Then there is a nonzero $w \in \mathbb{Z}_2^m$ with $w \cdot v_i = \sum_j w_j (v_i)_j = 0$ in $\mathbb{Z}_2$ for every $i$.
nodes.title: A nonzero vector of $\mathbb{Z}_2^m$ orthogonal to $a$ vectors when $a < m$

nodes.summary: Let $a + 1 \le m$ and let $X_1, \dots, X_a$ be finite sets of natural numbers. Then there is a nonempty set $Y \subseteq \{1, \dots, m\}$ such that $|Y \cap X_i|$ is even for every $i$.
nodes.title: A nonempty subset of $\{1, \dots, m\}$ meeting $a$ given sets evenly

Then every sequence $x_1, \dots, x_{m + \Omega(n)}$ in $\mathbb{Z}_n = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ has a unit-weighted zero-sum subsequence of length $m$: there are a set $I \subseteq \{1, \dots, m + \Omega(n)\}$ with $|I| = m$ and units $a_i$ of $\mathbb{Z}_n$ for $i \in I$…
nodes.title: Unit-weighted zero sums of even length in $\mathbb{Z}_n$

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{Z}_2 = \mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$ and let $m$ be even with $2^a \le m$. Then every subspace $W$ of $\mathbb{Z}_2^{m+a}$ of dimension $m$ contains a vector with exactly $m$ coordinates equal to $1$.
nodes.title: Every $m$-dimensional subspace of $\mathbb{Z}_2^{m+a}$ has a vector of weight $m$

nodes.summary: Let $a$ and $m$ be natural numbers with $m$ even and $2^a \le m$, write $\mathbb{Z}_2 = \mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$, and let $v_1, \dots, v_a$ be vectors in $\mathbb{Z}_2^{m+a}$. Then there is a vector $w \in \mathbb{Z}_2^{m+a}$ with exactly $m$ coordinates equal to $1$ such that $w \cdot v_i = \sum_j w_j (v_i)_j = 0$ for every $i$.
nodes.title: A weight-$m$ vector orthogonal to given vectors of $\mathbb{Z}_2^{m+a}$

nodes.summary: Let $a$ and $m$ be natural numbers with $m$ even and $2^a \le m$, and write $\mathbb{Z}_2 = \mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$. Every sequence $(x_1, \dots, x_{m+a})$ of length $m + a$ in $\mathbb{Z}_2^a$ has a zero-sum subsequence of length $m$: there is a set $I$ of exactly $m$ indices with $\sum_{i \in I} x_i = 0$.
nodes.title: Zero-sum subsequences of length $m$ in $\mathbb{Z}_2^a$

nodes.title: Unit-weighted Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv constant of $\mathbb{Z}_n$ for even $n$

nodes.summary: Let $a$ and $m$ be natural numbers with $m$ even and $2^a \le m$, and write $\mathbb{Z}_2 = \mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$. The largest dimension of a subspace of $\mathbb{Z}_2^{m+a}$ containing no vector with exactly $m$ coordinates equal to $1$ is $m - 1$.
nodes.title: Largest subspaces of $\mathbb{Z}_2^{m+a}$ with no vector of weight $m$

nodes.summary: Let $r \ge 1$, let $n = 2^r$, let $U(n)$ be the set of units of $\mathbb{Z}_n = \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$, and let $x = (x_1, \dots, x_{n+r-1})$ be a sequence in $\mathbb{Z}_n$ with no $U(n)$-weighted zero-sum subsequence of length $n$: there is no set $I$ of exactly $n$ indices with units $a_i \in U(n)$ for $i \in I$ such that $\sum_{i \in I} a_i x_i = 0$. Then $x$ is $U(n)$-equivalent to a sequence…
nodes.title: Structure of extremal sequences for unit-weighted zero sums of length $2^r$

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $n'$ and $k$ be natural numbers, put $n = p n'$, and let $z_1, \dots, z_k \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. Write $\bar z_i$ for the reduction of $z_i$ modulo $n'$. If there are units $a_1, \dots, a_k$ of $\mathbb{Z}/n'\mathbb{Z}$ with $\sum_i a_i \bar z_i = 0$, then there are units $b_1, \dots, b_k$ of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ with $\sum_i b_i \, p z_i = 0$.
nodes.title: Unit-weighted zero sums of multiples of a prime

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $r$ and $k$ be natural numbers, put $n = p^r$, and let $x_1, \dots, x_k \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$. Suppose that for each $i \in [1, r]$ the set $X_i = \{j : x_j \not\equiv 0 \pmod{p^i}\}$ has an even number of elements. Then there are units $a_1, \dots, a_k$ of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ with $a_1 x_1 + \dots + a_k x_k = 0$.
nodes.title: Griffiths' criterion for unit-weighted zero sums modulo a prime power

nodes.summary: Let $r$ and $k$ be natural numbers and let $x_1, \dots, x_k \in \mathbb{Z}/2^r\mathbb{Z}$. If the number of indices $j$ for which $x_j$ is a unit is even and nonzero, then there are units $a_1, \dots, a_k$ of $\mathbb{Z}/2^r\mathbb{Z}$ with $a_1 x_1 + \dots + a_k x_k = 0$.
nodes.title: Luca's lemma on unit-weighted zero sums modulo $2^r$

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field and $A$ a proper subgroup of the multiplicative group $F^\times$. Then some sequence $x_1, x_2$ in $F$ has no $A$-weighted zero-sum subsequence: there is no nonempty $I \subseteq \{1, 2\}$ with weights $a_i \in A$ for $i \in I$ such that $\sum_{i \in I} a_i x_i = 0$.
nodes.title: Weighted zero-sum free pairs for a proper subgroup of $F^\times$

nodes.summary: Let $k \ge 2$, let $p$ be a prime with $p \equiv 1 \pmod k$, and let $U(p)^k = \{u^k : u \in \mathbb{Z}_p^\times\}$. Then some sequence $x_1, x_2$ in $\mathbb{Z}_p$ has no $U(p)^k$-weighted zero-sum subsequence: there is no nonempty $I \subseteq \{1, 2\}$ with weights $a_i \in U(p)^k$ for $i \in I$ such that $\sum_{i \in I} a_i x_i = 0$.
nodes.title: Weighted zero-sum free pairs for $k$-th power weights modulo a prime

nodes.summary: Let $k$ be an odd prime and $p$ a prime with $p \equiv 1 \pmod{k}$ and $p \not\equiv 1 \pmod{k^2}$. Let $\mathbb{Z}_p = \mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$ and let $U(p)^k$ be the set of $k$-th powers of units of $\mathbb{Z}_p$. Then every sequence $x_1, \dots, x_k$ of $k$ elements of $\mathbb{Z}_p$ has a $U(p)^k$-weighted zero-sum subsequence: there are a nonempty set $I \subseteq \{1, \dots, k\}$ and weights $a_i \in U(p)^k$…
nodes.title: Davenport constant of $\mathbb{Z}_p$ with $k$-th power unit weights is at most $k$

nodes.summary: Let $F$ be a field, let $A$ be a subgroup of the multiplicative group $F^*$, and let $x, y \in F$ be nonzero. Then the sequence $(x_1, x_2) = (x, y)$ has no $A$-weighted zero-sum subsequence, that is, there is no nonempty set $I \subseteq \{1, 2\}$ with elements $a_i \in A$ for $i \in I$ such that $\sum_{i \in I} a_i x_i = 0$, if and only if $x$ and $-y$ lie in different cosets of $A$ in $F^*$.
nodes.title: Weighted zero-sum free pairs in a field
